name: claude-unimath
description: Universal RTL + mathematics support for Claude Desktop on macOS. Detects every right-to-left script and isolates LaTeX/KaTeX and English as left-to-right islands so mixed-direction text with math renders correctly.
author: Davidi Bellaire (https://github.com/DavidiBellaire)

scripts.test: node scripts/build.js --check && node test/core.test.js && node test/dom.test.js && node test/payload.test.js
